title: UUID
description: A Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) as defined in [RFC9562](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9562). When using UUIDv8 implementations MUST ensure that separate resources are assigned unique identifiers. Note that NMOS IS-04 currently only accepts UUID versions 1-5 (see [AMWA-TV/is-04#205](https://github.com/AMWA-TV/is-04/issues/205)), so implementations SHOULD prefer UUID versions 1-5, where interoperability with NMOS IS-04 is required.
